filament_slots.AMS lite slot 3: PETG green (food path) - Generic PETG @BBL A1, #2E9D4F

chassis.name: chassis 6.4 (mechanics + electronics-case holder)
chassis.note: TPU-2 (cap lip seal + module gasket, shared plate) is counted separately in shared_plate_TPU_2

validation.method: OrcaSlicer 2.5.0 Linux CLI (AppImage) opened each Bambu project 3MF and sliced all plates with the settings embedded in the project (--slice 0 --export-statistics); no Bambu Studio binary was available here, so the files were not opened in Bambu Studio itself
validation.bambu_profiles: BambuStudio master, resources/profiles/BBL, profile version 02.09.00.74, fetched 2026-11-09

ip66_filament_overrides.note: Generic PETG @BBL A1 with the part fan limited to 40 % (nozzle stays at the profile 255 C)

M3_modulo_vasca_v64_bottom_edge.note: 6.4.0 final CAD: bottom edge and the 5 lid-screw bosses need no support (boss enforcers removed); with support off the slicer still flags the two upper corners of the button recess (print z 21.5): 2 enforcers there, see extra_checks

M2_guscio_v64_tabs.supports: tree(manual), build plate only, 45 deg, 3 support enforcers under the inner part of the tabs

m7_lid_skin.note: 0.2 mm skin at print z 12.2..12.4 = exactly one 0.2 mm layer; no supports

modulo_vasca_v64_bosses.first_6_4_issue: without supports OrcaSlicer reported 'floating regions': the 5 lid-screw bosses started as free cone tips at print z 51.6; that package used 5 support enforcers (3.2 g)
modulo_vasca_v64_bosses.final_6_4_0: bosses grow from the wall on 45 deg corbels; the 5 boss enforcers are removed; the tub cut above print z 23 slices with support off without warning

extra_checks.fondello_v64_ledge: round well of the cap (assembly axis x -40, y 0): the 0.6 mm bore-side strip is now a 45 deg chamfer; the 1.5 mm flat ring that retains the chute lip stays and prints as a short overhang at print z 29.3 (225 mm2 instead of 300 mm2); no slicer warning
extra_checks.scatola_v64_lug_and_hook: the harness tie lug and the C-hook on the south post start on the bed (roof down): no region in mid-air, no support, no warning
extra_checks.modulo_coperchio_v64: back fence added for the harness loop; the J1 skin is still sliced as one bridge layer at print z 12.4; no support, no warning
extra_checks.zero_volume_fins: none left in the 6.4.0 print files (all 8 load as one watertight body)
extra_checks.elefant_foot_compensation_object_overrid: verified on a test slice: the per-object value changes the first-layer outline (0.075 -> 0.30 moved the outer radius of the speaker ring by 0.225 mm)
extra_checks.guscio_v64_supports: G-code check (first 6.4 issue, shell file unchanged in shape): support only in three clusters at the tab angles, radius 49..75 mm from the shell axis, print z 0.2..63.8
extra_checks.test_coupons: test_groove_cap (961.6 mm3) and test_cap_lip (77.7 mm3) cut from the 6.4.0 parts have the same volume and size as the 6.3 coupons

modulo_vasca_v64_button_recess.finding: with support off the full final tub still gets "floating regions"; band bisection (support off): cut at z<=12 and z<=20 no warning, z<=24 warning; part above z 23 or 24.5 no warning
modulo_vasca_v64_button_recess.cause: the two upper corners of the d17 button recess where its rim meets the leaning outer skin start as free slivers at print z 21.5 (assembly (57.1, 12.2, -82.5) and (53.1, 26.3, -82.4)) and join the skin about 2.5 mm higher
modulo_vasca_v64_button_recess.used: 2 support enforcers (4 x 4 x 3.2 mm) placed automatically on the floating starts found by a layer check in print z 15..30; normal(manual), not build plate only: two thin columns from the bed outside the panel face, 0.5 g
modulo_vasca_v64_button_recess.note: OrcaSlicer runs its floating-region check only with support off, so the absence of the warning in the project (support on) is backed by the band slices and the layer check, not by the project slice itself
modulo_vasca_v64_button_recess.cad_fix_suggested: 45 deg or teardrop top on the button recess rim

plates.name: 00 TEST - spline + rim, cap and skirt grooves
plates.purpose: print first: spline clearance for mozzo_v6; groove coupons for the TPU test strips
plates.status_note: same coupons as print_v63 PETG-0 (the cap coupon is now cut from the 6.4 cap: same groove section, same size). If you printed and judged the 6.3 test plate, do not print it again

parts.label: Spline fit test (3 coupons)
parts.print_note: socket on the bed; 1/2/3 notches = 0.05/0.10/0.20 mm radial clearance; mozzo_v6 is built with 0.10

parts.label: Bowl rim groove coupon (30 mm cut of chiocciola_v63)
parts.print_note: rim with the 3.0 x 2.2 lip-seal groove; cut face on the bed

parts.label: Cap upstand groove coupon (20 mm cut of fondello_v64)
parts.print_note: straight side of the cap upstand with the 2.2 x 1.15 retaining groove (same section as the 6.3 coupon); cut face on the bed

parts.label: Flange skirt groove coupon (30 mm cut of flangia_piano_v63)
parts.print_note: plate edge with the skirt-lip groove (groove up); shelf face on the bed

plates.name: 01 BLACK - pod shell 6.4
plates.purpose: the 6.4 shell with the module opening; 6 mm brim; tree supports under the 3 bowl tabs only
plates.status_note: replaces print_v63 PETG-1 (shell 6.1.1 + electronics box 6.3): both of those parts are obsolete

parts.label: Pod shell (module opening, return ribs)
parts.print_note: top edge (z +64) on the bed, opening upward; 5 walls; 6 mm brim; tree supports from the build plate only (45 deg) under the inner 12 mm of the 3 bowl tabs, placed by 3 support enforcers (manual mode: nothing else gets support)

plates.name: 02 BLACK - bowl
plates.purpose: single colour (black); bowl lugs on bed-only supports
plates.status_note: the bowl at its print_v63 position; print_v63 PETG-2 also held the 6.3 cap, which is obsolete: if you printed that plate, keep the bowl and do not print this plate

parts.label: Bowl (PT pilots, P3 insert moved)
parts.print_note: flat base on the bed; supports on build plate only (3 bayonet lugs)

plates.name: 03 BLACK - lower flange + tower + shaft + hub
plates.purpose: single colour (black); the shaft at 0.15 mm layers needs a plate without prime tower

parts.label: Lower flange plate (dowel hole)
parts.print_note: shelf-side face on the bed (d4.0 x 2.7 dowel hole); press the 4 x 6 dowel in after printing; no supports

parts.label: Tower (3 pillars)
parts.print_note: upright, flange on the bed; 100 % infill (the pillars carry the M3x40 preload)

parts.label: Shaft
parts.print_note: bottom hex on the bed; 100 % infill; 0.15 mm layers; 5 mm brim

parts.label: Servo hub
parts.print_note: spline socket on the bed (print test_scanalato first); 100 % infill

plates.name: 04 BLACK - upper flange
plates.purpose: single colour (black); the second d180 plate cannot share a plate with another big part

parts.label: Upper flange plate (3 press-fit pins, tie window)
parts.print_note: shelf face on the bed, the 3 press-fit pins grow up; no supports

plates.name: 05 GREEN+black - chute + collar + gate blade + gate + window plates
plates.purpose: food path and gate: green parts + the two 3 mm plates (black body, green bands)

parts.label: Chute
parts.print_note: joint flange on the bed; no supports

parts.label: Funnel collar
parts.print_note: flipped, top rim on the bed; no supports

parts.label: Gate blade (one colour)
parts.print_note: flat on the bed, green only; 100 % infill (3 mm blade)

parts.label: Window plate
parts.print_note: flipped: green FOOD IN band in the first 3 layers

parts.label: Gate plate
parts.print_note: bottom face on the bed; green OUT band in the top 3 layers

plates.name: 06 ORANGE+black - interlock ring + disc + latch + button
plates.purpose: orange parts; the disc prints inside the ring; black disc label only in the first 3 layers

parts.label: Interlock ring (teardrop window)
parts.print_note: on its bottom edge; the window is a 45 deg teardrop: no support; 5 mm outer brim

parts.label: Dosing disc (self-cleaning)
parts.print_note: flipped, disc top on the bed; black label in the first 3 layers; no supports

parts.label: Safety latch

parts.label: Latch push-button
parts.print_note: standing on its head face; 100 % infill

plates.name: 07 BLACK IP66 - servo bay + pod cap 6.4
plates.purpose: the two sealed chassis parts; IP66 object settings and the low-fan filament settings of this project; no supports

parts.label: Servo bay + module holder posts

plates.name: M1 BLACK IP66 - module tub + speaker ring
plates.purpose: the sealed tub (pod skin, control panel, board slots) and the speaker ring; no supports; 2 mouse ears on the tub

parts.label: Module tub (outer skin, control panel, board slots)
parts.print_note: standing as assembled (flat bottom on the bed); IP66 settings; elephant-foot compensation 0.15; bottom edge, rim and the 5 lid-screw bosses need no support (45 deg faces since 6.4.0); two thin support columns from the bed, outside the tub, under the two upper corners of the button recess (print z 21.5), placed by support enforcers; 2 mouse ears (d16 x 0.2) on the back corners against lifting of the 2 mm back wall: cut them off

parts.label: Speaker ring (for a d23 speaker)
parts.print_note: flat; any colour (it sits inside the sealed module; the viewer shows it orange)

plates.name: M2 BLACK IP66 - module lid
plates.purpose: the lid on its own plate: check the bought M8 socket (thread and nut size) before printing it

parts.label: Module lid (J1 turret, gasket groove)
parts.print_note: underside on the bed, turret up; IP66 settings; NO supports; the J1 hole is closed by a 0.2 mm skin (one layer, 13 mm bridge): drill it d8.2 afterwards (or the thread size of the bought socket); the back fence on the top guides the harness loop

plates.name: M3 TPU 95A - module gasket (only when the module is reprinted alone)
plates.purpose: the module gasket alone, for reprinting the module later; it is also on chassis plate TPU-2

parts.label: Module lid lip gasket
parts.print_note: base on the bed, lip up; Arachne walls, 15 mm/s (the thin lip prints as one line)
